title: 대도시권광역교통위원회 직제 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose): This regulation aims to define the rank and number of staff for the auxiliary organization under the Metropolitan Area Comprehensive Transportation Committee, as well as to specify the establishment and office assignments of auxiliary organizations under the Metropolitan Area Comprehensive Transportation Committee, in accordance with Article 2(3) and (4) of the "Public Organization Act," and to address any other matters necessary for the implementation of the "Organization Regulations of the Metropolitan Area Comprehensive Transportation Committee."
